title: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 daily downscaled climate (raw)
description: NASA daily downscaled CMIP6 projections. The ultimate upstream source for every hazard index in this pipeline.

transfer.rationale: Public, anonymous, no egress cost to us, and ships a per-file MD5 index of 36,165 entries. Any host fetches it directly; never copy it host-to-host.
transfer.approx_size: tens of TB for the full archive; only the needed variables/GCMs/years are pulled

gaps: Per-host on-disk footprint not inventoried; the pipeline only needs a subset.

changelog.change: Record created. Confirmed the bucket and MD5 index are publicly reachable anonymously.
Acquisition recipe registered; this is now the only supported way to fetch it.

acquire.note: Pulls from the public NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 bucket. Honours COMMON_DATA and the GCMS/SSPS/YRS shard variables, so fetch only the slice a run needs. Verify against the published MD5 index rather than trusting file counts.
